# First Open School

> Open Early Childhood Literacy, Numeracy, Poetry & Kids Encyclopedia Platform.
> Created by Umer Idrisi (Blogger & Entrepreneur from Pakistan) | A Project of Arkade Digital Limited (UK).
> Inspired by the Computer Language Company (CDE) clarity, evidence-based phonemic instruction, subitizing, and tactile handwriting motor mechanics.

First Open School is a 100% free, ad-free, interactive educational platform designed for early learners, preschoolers, elementary students, and parents worldwide (Ages 2 to 12+).

## Core Learning Modules & Interactive Hubs

- [Home Learning World](https://firstopenschool.com/): Interactive hub with age-tier switching (Pre-K to Elementary), live milestone badges, star tracker, and daily learning streaks.
- [Alphabets A-Z](https://firstopenschool.com/alphabets): Complete 26-letter phonics curriculum with uppercase/lowercase recognition, audio phonics sounds, mouth shape formation guides, and vocabulary associations.
- [Digits 0-20](https://firstopenschool.com/digits): Early numeracy and subitizing curriculum focusing on dot patterns, ten-frames, visual grouping, audio counting, number bonds, and numeral formation.
- [Kids Encyclopedia](https://firstopenschool.com/encyclopedia): Modeled on Computer Language Company (CDE) principles. Features plain-English definitions, phonetic guides, memorable everyday analogies, visual breakdowns, ancient historical origins, hands-on kitchen experiments, and micro-quizzes across 8 knowledge domains.
- [144+ Easy Poems & Rhymes](https://firstopenschool.com/poems): Expansive poetry and nursery rhyme collection with read-aloud audio narration, rhythmic cadence highlighting, vocabulary definitions with emojis, and physical recital tips for kids.
  - [Pakistani Poems & Rhymes](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/pakistani-rhymes): Traditional Urdu nursery rhymes, Allama Iqbal moral fables (*Lab Pe Aati Hai Dua*, *Pahar Aur Gulehri*, *Jugnu*), and counting games with bilingual English translations.
  - [Rhymes Around the World](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/world-rhymes): Global folk verses and clapping songs from the Caribbean, Africa, Europe, Asia, Latin America, and Celtic traditions.
  - [Classics & Nursery Rhymes](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/classics-rhymes): Timeless English nursery rhymes and early childhood ballads.
  - [Animals & Nature](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/animals-nature): Verses celebrating birds, cows, caterpillars, and wildlife.
  - [Bedtime & Lullabies](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/bedtime-lullabies): Soothing bedtime poems for evening calm and dreaming.
  - [Fun & Playful Verses](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/fun-whimsical): Bouncy counting, fingerplay, and clapping games.
  - [Manners & Good Habits](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/good-habits): Verses teaching tooth brushing, hand washing, and sharing.
  - [Seasons & Weather](https://firstopenschool.com/poems/category/seasons-weather): Verses celebrating rain, rainbows, autumn leaves, and sunshine.
- [Drawings & Offline Printables Studio](https://firstopenschool.com/drawings): Creative digital art canvas (wax crayon, paintbrush, rainbow pen, stickers, eraser) plus 30+ printable coloring activity sheets for parents to download and print for tabletop art.
- [Handwriting Tracing](https://firstopenschool.com/tracing): Multi-touch HTML5 canvas with directional stroke guidance, fine-motor path detection, and instant stroke accuracy calculation for letters and digits.
- [Bubble Pop Phonics Game](https://firstopenschool.com/bubble-pop): Fast-paced audio-visual letter and sound recall game.
- [Monster Counting Feast](https://firstopenschool.com/counting-feast): Gamified subitizing and snack-counting number sense game.
- [Phonics Memory Match](https://firstopenschool.com/card-match): Memory card matching game pairing letters with phonics vocabulary images.
- [Decodable Phonics Stories](https://firstopenschool.com/phonics-stories): 110+ single-sentence decodable stories with word-by-word audio highlighting and reading comprehension questions.
- [Star Assessment Quiz](https://firstopenschool.com/assessment): Gamified quiz engine testing letter sounds, numbers, and patterns with graduation milestone rewards.
- [Parent & Educator Dashboard](https://firstopenschool.com/parental-dashboard): Learning analytics, time-on-task, phonics accuracy metrics, AI Pedagogical Coach, and printable completion certificates.

## Encyclopedia Knowledge Clusters (80+ In-Depth Articles)

1. **Alphabets A-Z (26 letters)**: Aa through Zz with analogies, mouth mechanics, phonetic symbols, ancient Phoenician/Greek origins, tongue twisters, and hands-on tactile craft projects.
2. **Numbers & Math Sense**: Zero (0), One (1), Two (2), Ten (10), One Hundred (100), Fractions & Halves, Geometry & Shapes, and Infinity (∞).
3. **Solar System & Space**: The Sun, Planet Earth, The Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Black Holes, and Rockets & Astronauts.
4. **Earth & Nature Elements**: Water Cycle (H2O), Rainbows & Light Spectrum, Volcanoes & Magma, Trees & Photosynthesis, Lightning & Thunder, and The 4 Seasons.
5. **Animals & Dinosaurs**: Tyrannosaurus Rex, Blue Whale, Honeybees, Chameleon, Cheetah, Owls, Butterflies & Metamorphosis, Octopus, and Triceratops.
6. **Human Body & Senses**: The Human Brain, Heart & Blood, The 5 Senses, Skeleton & Bones, Lungs & Breathing, and Taste Buds & Tongue.
7. **How Things Work & Engineering**: How Airplanes Fly (Lift/Bernoulli), How the Internet Works (Packets/Wi-Fi), How Clocks Tell Time (Gears/Quartz), Wheels & Gears, Electricity & Circuits, and How Cameras Work.
8. **World Geography & Continents**: The 7 Continents, World Oceans, The Great Wall of China, Mount Everest, Japan, Egypt, Brazil, and Antarctica.

## AI & Developer API Endpoints

- `POST /api/encyclopedia-ask`: Accepts `{ query: string, topic: string }` and returns a CDE-style structured encyclopedia entry with everyday analogies, mouth mechanics, origins, and micro-quizzes.
- `POST /api/ai-parent-coach`: Accepts student mastery percentages and returns developmental early childhood insights.
- `GET /api/health`: Health status endpoint returning platform uptime, version, and environment.
